results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Senior Operations Manager – Contract Logistics & Warehousing
results.description: We are supporting a leading 3PL and contract logistics business in the UAE with the appointment of a Senior Operations Manager to lead a complex, high-volume warehousing operation in Dubai. The successful candidate will take ownership of operational performance across warehousing, inventory, customer SLAs, productivity, cost control and continuous improvement, while leading and developing a sizeable operations team. Key responsibilities include: Lead day-to-day warehouse and contract logistics operations Deliver agreed customer SLAs, KPIs and service levels Drive warehouse productivity, capacity utilisation and operational efficiency Maintain high levels of inventory accuracy and stock integrity Manage operational budgets, labour costs and indirect expenditure Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives Ensure effective utilisation of WMS and operational reporting systems Lead, coach and develop warehouse operations teams Work closely with customer service, transport and commercial teams Maintain strong standards across HSSE, compliance and operational procedures Candidate profile: 8+ years’ experience within 3PL, contract logistics or large-scale warehousing Proven experience leading complex warehouse operations and sizeable teamsPrevious experience leading warehouse operations and sizeable teams Strong understanding of WMS, inventory control and warehouse KPIs Demonstrable experience managing customer SLAs and operational performance Commercial understanding of warehouse costs, productivity and resource planning Strong continuous improvement and problem-solving capability UAE/GCC logistics experience would be advantageous This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced logistics professional looking to take ownership of a complex, customer-focused operation in Dubai.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Director, Event Mobility Planning
results.description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter and more connected. We are a key delivery partner on one of Saudi Arabia’s flagship giga projects and a central pillar of Vision 2030, located approximately 45 km southwest of Riyadh. Designed as the Kingdom’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture, this landmark development aims to diversify the economy and enhance quality of life through a mix of world-class attractions, residential communities, and natural landscapes, while generating significant employment and enabling long-term, sustainable growth. About The Opportunity The Director, Event Mobility Planning leads the development and delivery of integrated mobility planning for major events, festivals, sporting competitions, and entertainment activations. The role is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and coordinated movement of guests, athletes, VIPs, workforce, logistics, emergency services, and public transport users across venues and districts. Acting as the City Operations mobility lead, the position develops citywide mobility standards, demand forecasts, traffic and event mobility plans, and operational readiness arrangements, supporting major events through 2028 while coordinating with venue and asset operators who retain responsibility for operations within their controlled areas. Role Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of event mobility strategy, governance framework, standards, policies, and operating model. Direct integrated mobility planning for major events, festivals, sporting competitions, and entertainment activations across the destination. Develop transport demand forecasts, mobility plans, and arrival/departure strategies for guests, VIPs, athletes, performers, workforce, media, and emergency services. Coordinate mobility requirements across multiple concurrent events to optimize network performance, capacity, and operational resilience. Oversee traffic management, access control, road network planning, parking strategies, vehicle accreditation, and emergency access arrangements. Integrate public transport, shuttle services, taxis, ride-hailing, active mobility, and last-mile connectivity into event operations. Develop secure and efficient mobility solutions for VIP, hospitality, protocol, government, and specialist stakeholder movements. Coordinate logistics, servicing, freight, contractor, and emergency service movements to ensure seamless event operations. Lead operational readiness activities, simulations, test events, command-and-control planning, live event mobility operations, and post-event reviews. Manage relationships with government authorities, transport operators, emergency services, event organizers, venues, and suppliers while overseeing budgets, contracts, procurement, and service performance. Here's what you'll need Role Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Transport Planning, Civil/Transportation Engineering, Urban Planning, Logistics, Operations Management, or a related field; Master’s degree and professional certifications are preferred. 18+ years of experience in transport planning, mobility operations, traffic engineering, major event transportation, city operations, or infrastructure, including significant senior leadership experience. Proven track record delivering mobility planning and operations for large-scale sporting, entertainment, cultural, or destination events. Expertise in transport demand forecasting, event mobility planning, traffic management, parking strategies, public transport integration, operational readiness, and incident management. Strong experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholders, transport authorities, venues, operators, consultants, budgets, contracts, and supplier performance. Knowledge of mobility technologies, intelligent transport systems, accessibility, sustainability, risk management, command and control operations, and cross-functional coordination within complex event environments. results.title: Executive Director – Logistics
results.description: We are seeking an experienced Executive Director – Logistics to lead and grow its logistics business. The role will have broad responsibility for business strategy, commercial performance, operations, customer development and team leadership. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualification preferred. 15 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding or a related industry. At least 5 years in a senior leadership role with significant commercial and P&L responsibility. Proven track record of building, transforming or scaling a logistics business. Strong commercial background with experience in business development, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships. Broad knowledge of freight and logistics operations, ideally across multiple modes and markets. Demonstrated ability to deliver revenue, profitability and growth targets. Experience leading and developing large, multicultural teams. Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen and execution capability. Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management and communication skills. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a growth and transformation environment. Fluent English required; Arabic is an advantage. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute the business strategy and growth plan for the logistics business. Lead commercial development across key markets, customers and industry sectors. Build and manage strategic relationships with customers, logistics partners, carriers and other key stakeholders. Drive revenue, profitability, customer growth and overall P&L performance. Develop and optimize logistics products and solutions across relevant modes and services. Establish efficient operational processes, service standards and performance KPIs. Identify new market, customer and partnership opportunities to accelerate growth. Lead the development of a high-performing organization, including recruitment, capability building and succession planning. Ensure strong governance across compliance, risk, quality, safety and operational performance. Drive the use of technology and digital solutions to improve efficiency and customer experience. Represent the organization with key customers, partners, regulators and industry stakeholders. Work closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver strategic objectives.

results.title: Head of Distribution | FMCG Distribution | Dubai
results.description: We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Head of Distribution to lead our end-to-end distribution operations across the UAE and GCC. This leadership role is responsible for driving commercial growth, optimizing the supply chain, expanding distribution networks, and strengthening retail partnerships . The ideal candidate has a proven track record in FMCG distribution management , strong business acumen, and deep knowledge of sales, logistics, and market dynamics in the region. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Distribution Management: Develop and implement the distribution strategy for all channels — modern trade, general trade, wholesale, export, and travel retail. Ensure effective coverage and product availability across key retail partners, distributors, and regional markets. Lead the company’s efforts to expand into new territories and retail chains . Define and monitor KPIs to ensure high efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Align distribution objectives with overall sales, marketing, and brand strategy . Sales & Channel Development: Oversee sales performance and profitability across all distribution channels. Negotiate trade terms, pricing, and contracts with key accounts and distribution partners. Identify opportunities for market expansion, new product distribution, and strategic alliances . Support the sales team with planning, forecasting, and regional growth initiatives. Develop strategic B2B and wholesale partnerships to strengthen market reach. Supply Chain & Operations: Work closely with logistics, procurement, and warehousing teams to ensure smooth and timely delivery of goods. Oversee inventory planning, demand forecasting, and replenishment cycles. Optimize distribution routes, delivery efficiency, and logistics cost structures . Ensure compliance with food safety, quality control, and regulatory standards . Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor the distribution, sales operations, and logistics teams. Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, efficiency, and service excellence. Foster collaboration between sales, marketing, and supply chain departments. Ensure continuous team development through training and performance management. Financial & Performance Oversight: Manage P&L for the distribution division , ensuring profitability and cost optimization. Develop and track annual budgets, forecasts, and operational targets . Provide regular reports and performance insights to senior management. Implement continuous improvement initiatives to maximize ROI on distribution operations. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field. 10+ years of experience in FMCG distribution, sales, or operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role . Proven success in managing multi-channel distribution networks (modern trade, wholesale, and export). Strong understanding of logistics, supply chain, and inventory systems . Excellent leadership, negotiation, and analytical skills . Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Odoo, Zoho, or similar) and data reporting tools. Strategic thinker with hands-on problem-solving ability. Fluent in English (Arabic is a plus). Must have a strong network in the UAE and GCC FMCG market . Why Join Us? Lead and scale the distribution arm of a premium, fast-growing chocolate and food brand . Opportunity to shape strategy, lead expansion, and drive regional market dominance . Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and executive benefits . Join an ambitious and passionate team focused on growth and excellence. Location: Dubai, UAE Employment Type: Full-time | Senior Leadership Role

results.title: Airfreight Manager
results.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: About the Role The Air Freight Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of the airfreight function, including product development, commercial performance, and operational execution. This role drives the growth and profitability of the airfreight business while ensuring seamless shipment handling, strong carrier partnerships, and high service standards. Responsibilities Product & Strategy Develop and execute the airfreight strategy aligned with overall freight forwarding objectives. Build competitive service offerings across key trade lanes and industry verticals. Identify and develop specialized services (e.g., pharma, perishables, e-commerce, DG). Monitor market trends, rates, and capacity to proactively adjust strategy. Operational Management Lead and manage the Airfreight Import & Export teams. Ensure smooth end-to-end shipment execution in line with SOPs and service standards. Drive operational efficiency, productivity, and quality performance. Manage escalations and implement corrective actions where required. Carrier & Supplier Management Develop and maintain strong relationships with airlines, GSAs, and partners. Negotiate competitive rates, contracts, and capacity agreements. Secure space allocation, especially during peak seasons. Monitor carrier performance and ensure service reliability. Commercial & Financial Performance Own airfreight P&L, including revenue, GP, and cost control. Develop pricing strategies and maintain rate structures. Support RFQs, tenders, and key customer solutions. Drive yield improvement and profitability across shipments. Sales Support & Business Growth Partner with sales teams to grow volumes and strategic accounts. Provide pricing guidance, market insights, and solution design. Support customer acquisition and retention efforts. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Ocean Freight and Customs Brokerage teams to ensure integrated service delivery. Ensure alignment across departments for seamless customer experience. Contribute to overall freight forwarding performance and growth. Performance & Reporting Monitor OKRs including volume, revenue, margins, and service levels. Provide regular reports and forecasts to the Head of Freight Forwarding. Analyze trade lane performance and drive continuous improvement. Qualifications 6–10 years of experience in airfreight within a freight forwarding environment. Proven experience handling both operations and commercial/product responsibilities. Strong background in airline negotiations, pricing, and trade lane management. Experience managing airfreight import/export teams. Required Skills Strong leadership and team management skills. Commercial acumen with P&L ownership mindset. Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capability. Deep understanding of airfreight operations and global market dynamics. Ability to balance operational execution with strategic growth. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills IATA certification. Experience in the Middle East market. Exposure to specialized cargo segments.
